region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis threshold-add front end HCT1BA01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCATDB01 (which inserts the THRESHOLD row) and RETURNs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). scenarios.name: add-threshold
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN covers the header: one THRESHOLD row inserted for patient 1, CA-RETURN-CODE '00' (LINKed through HCATDB01)

scenarios.name: add-threshold-second-patient
scenarios.why: a second patient: the key is patientId, the insert succeeds

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98' to CA-RETURN-CODE, RETURN before any INSERT

scenarios.name: duplicate-patient
scenarios.why: seed.sql holds a THRESHOLD row for patient 2: INSERT is -803, '90'; the front end sees CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 and RETURNs
